decoder: System.Reflection.Metadata PEReader with framework opcode table
limitations: callvirt/ldvirtftn targets are declared methods, not a points-to or virtual-dispatch analysis.
Unity serialization/events, reflection, native callbacks and dynamically loaded dependencies are not resolved by this graph.
ldftn/ldvirtftn are function-pointer references, not evidence the pointed-to function was called.
IL2CPP runtime equivalence with shipped native implementation requires C++/native correlation.
No-RVA and one-byte-ret entries are explicitly distinguished; no inferred C# implementation generated.
